twofa.intro: Protect your account with a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password...) in addition to your password.
twofa.openApp: On this phone? Open the authenticator app directly
twofa.saveCodes: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one can sign you in once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
twofa.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone.
twofa.step2: Add an account in the app and enter this setup key (time-based):
twofa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
